UBP kernel matches official rasterize_to_pixels_bwd.cu v_xy_sqr_local (per-pixel square, 0.999 gate, sum x^2+y^2 over radii>0, same dL/dI normalisation 1/(3HW)). pytest 7 passed, ss-inspect clean x3, probes re-run on GPU 3 pass.
summary: Faithful line-level port of spotless_trainer.py @0caae3c; no critical or major issues. Headline = SLS-mlp + UBP, confirmed by Fig.3/4/5 == Fig.8 last row and by README 'SLS-mlp + UBP' (= sls_benchmark.sh --ubp, defaults). Recommend README 24.96 / 22.2 as primary target (exact code config, no GLO), paper 25.15 / 22.24 as secondary; compare deltas over our gsplat baseline with the README/paper 3DGS rows, noting the baseline config differs.
